intro: The winter calendar keeps giving — HOTA's dumpling masterclasses roll through their final two Wednesdays, the This Moment dining experience at Palette has been extended into October, and Second Coming plays its final week at La Boite. Saturday brings the songbook of Barbra Streisand to Twin Towns, with Vivaldi at QPAC on Tuesday. On the horizon: SWELL returns to Currumbin's sand in September, Brisbane Festival lights up the river from the 4th, and Anastasia sweeps into QPAC.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (18–25 Aug)

topPicks.name: The Way We Were — Streisand
topPicks.desc: Melinda Schneider celebrates the timeless songbook of Barbra Streisand — a dazzling concert night, 25 minutes down the road.

topPicks.name: Second Coming
topPicks.desc: Last chance for La Boite's love letter to Earth wrapped in corporate salvation — sharp, funny new Australian theatre.

topPicks.name: Dumpling Masterclass
topPicks.desc: The final two Wednesdays to roll, pleat and steam your way through dinner at HOTA — book the last spots.

topPicks.name: Vivaldi's Legacy
topPicks.desc: Baroque brilliance in QPAC's Concert Hall — a dramatic journey through Vivaldi's enduring legacy.

events.name: Dumpling Masterclass at HOTA
events.desc: Roll, pleat and steam your way through a hands-on dumpling evening — equal parts workshop and dinner, and a lovely plan for a cooler winter night.

events.name: This Moment — Dining at Palette
events.desc: HOTA's This Moment exhibition spills into Palette restaurant — art-inspired dining where the menu answers the gallery. A refined long lunch, ten minutes from the villa.

events.date: Final week — until Saturday 22 August · La Boite, Brisbane
events.name: Second Coming
events.desc: La Boite Theatre presents a love letter to Earth wrapped in the language of corporate salvation — sharp, funny and thought-provoking new Australian theatre.

events.name: The Way We Were — The Music of Barbra Streisand
events.desc: Melinda Schneider celebrates the timeless songbook of Barbra Streisand in a dazzling new concert event, just over the border at Twin Towns.
events.location: Twin Towns, Tweed Heads · 25 min drive

events.name: Vivaldi's Legacy
events.desc: Baroque brilliance at QPAC's Concert Hall — a dramatic journey through Vivaldi's enduring musical legacy. Worth the trip north for classical lovers.

events.name: SWELL Sculpture Festival
events.desc: The Gold Coast's most-loved outdoor gallery — large-scale sculptures along Currumbin's sand at sunrise, sunset and everything between. Free, iconic, unmissable.

events.name: Brisbane Festival 2026
events.desc: The city's biggest and boldest celebration of art and community — three weeks of theatre, music, dance and riverside spectacle across South Bank and beyond. Worth planning a day trip around.
events.location: South Bank & citywide, Brisbane · 75 min drive

events.name: Koreaboo
events.desc: A sharp new comedy at La Boite about identity, fandom and belonging — fresh Australian theatre with serious buzz.

events.name: Anastasia The Musical
events.desc: The sweeping Broadway musical journeys from the twilight of the Russian Empire to 1920s Paris — lavish, romantic and made for a special night out.

events.name: BLEACH Festival 2026
events.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival returns — eleven days of live music, theatre and large-scale spectacle at HOTA and across the city, headlined by Six60. The Coast at its most alive.
